# GfxDriver <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GfxDriver:Int32
```

**Returns:** The driver number, from 1 to [CountGfxDrivers](CountGfxDrivers).

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The number of the graphics driver that draws the program. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no way to ask which driver was picked. Once a graphics window is open it is the GPU in use, before that it is the driver that [SetGfxDriver](SetGfxDriver) chose, or 1.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
SetGfxDriver CountGfxDrivers()
Graphics3D 640, 480, 0, 2
Print "Drawing with " + GfxDriverName(GfxDriver())
WaitKey
```
